title: WTF: the Rise of the Tech Broligarchy
content:
MediaJustice presented a political education series to help activists understand the ‘tech broligarchy’. Please note the series ran from February to May 2025 and some details may be out of date. However, it remains a valuable overview of the dynamics shaping economics and politics in the US and globally.

In Trump’s first 100 days in office, the tech bro executives— who we call the Tech Broligarchy — proudly flaunted their corporate-state collusion to surveil, criminalize, and control us for profit. From Musk’s DOGE purging federal agencies and workers that might regulate his businesses to Palantir’s overlooked role in scaling mass ICE raids and daylight abductions, these Broligarchs are directly executing policy that only benefit themselves while undermining our democracy.

MediaJustice’s WTF: The Rise of the Tech Broligarchy Toolkit is a companion resource to the seven-part political education webinar series, which exposes and resists these tech billionaires and their agenda during Trump’s first 100 days in office and beyond. Download the toolkit to bring these conversations into your communities and build our collective power against the Tech Broligarchy.
